subject: 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway Comprehensive Permit
overview: The Zoning Board of Appeals met to review revised plans, requested waivers, and public safety conditions for the Chapter 40B comprehensive permit application at 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway. The board agreed to extend the review timeline and voted to continue the public hearing to May 24, 2023.

items.title: Introductory Remarks and Open Meeting Law Announcement
items.summary: Denis MacDougall read the statutory extension authorizing remote public meetings through March 31, 2025.

items.title: 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway Case Overview and Legal Clarifications
items.summary: The board resumed the public hearing for Case 40B-2022-01 and reviewed legal guidance regarding the board's authority on building code safety conditions and local preference options.

items.title: Applicant Revised Plan Presentation
items.summary: The applicant presented updated architectural, civil, and landscape plan sets, pointing out revisions to garage layouts, short-term loading zones, courtyard equipment storage, and internal drive lane striping.

items.title: Peer Review and Safety Official Comments
items.summary: Peer reviewers and Building Commissioner Bill Forte provided feedback on the revised plans, focusing on state fire code enforcement authority and phased construction occupancy considerations.

items.title: Board Questions on Site Plan Details
items.summary: Board members questioned the applicant regarding response matrix entries, courtyard door access, and pedestrian safety along internal driveways.

items.title: Waiver List Review
items.summary: The board discussed requested waivers from local ordinances—including solar assessment requirements, building permit processes, and signage—and requested printed plan sets for formal review.

items.title: Discussion on Security Features and Bike Parking Capacity
items.summary: The board evaluated security measures for the north side of the property and discussed options for expanding bicycle storage beyond the proposed 132 spaces.

items.title: Local Preference and Hearing Schedule Continuance
items.summary: The board reviewed local preference conditions for affordable units and voted to continue the public hearing to May 24, 2023.
